extDesc.message: MRU tab switcher — hold to cycle recent tabs, release to switch.

cmdOpen.message: Open the recent-tabs switcher (or advance forward)

cmdBack.message: Cycle backward / open at last card — set your own key in the shortcuts page

optCardCount.message: Number of cards in the switcher (4–9)

optThumbs.message: Tab previews (show a screenshot of each tab)

optThumbsNote.message: Previews are captured as you visit each tab (they don't work on internal pages like edge:// or New Tab).

optCtrlTab.message: Optional: bind the literal Ctrl+Tab. See the project README — note it disables the browser's native Ctrl+Tab tab cycling.

optOverrideDesc.message: Edge reserves Cmd+Shift+E (Bing/Copilot sidebar). You can force the extension's "back" command onto it with the snippet below. It's per-install and may reset on updates; reversible at edge://extensions/shortcuts.

optStep2.message: Open DevTools on that page (Cmd+Opt+I) and go to the Console.
